result.question: Where does the man of God go after the lie?

readings.support: went back with him, ate bread in his house

assessments.reason: Verse 13:19 states he “went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water,” so going to the old prophet’s house aligns with going back to eat and drink.

result.reason: The text explicitly says he went back with the old prophet and ate and drank in his house, matching the key’s “back to eat and drink.”
